explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows methotrexate injection on allocation since 2023-03-13 with multiple manufacturers reporting current shortages and estimated recovery in October 2026

sentences.text: FDA first posted the methotrexate sodium injection shortage on 2023-03-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-17.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 43 months.

Accord Healthcare Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc. (a Pfizer Company), and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. all show current shortage status with various package NDCs.
Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. indicates additional lots will be available in the October 2026 timeframe.
Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. estimates recovery in October 2026.
Fresenius Kabi USA LLC advises checking wholesaler for inventory.
Corvale East, General, and Lakeside hospitals hold 16-19 days of supply at current usage rates.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-d10262.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%methotrexate%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%methotrexate%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-b62fc9.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('3989d30d-56e5-4e8d-9379-c30fecc894f2', '346ec9ce-dc98-4a55-b55e-d3af11f2d703', '89c05ea3-3be1-46dd-b112-29c436fd7289', '59ea7b32-2b6d-4197-92c3-015936f04ebe') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-7cf611.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%methotrexate%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-4e231a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%methotrexate%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-332495.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%methotrexate%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%solution%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f5226e.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3007938603', '3002644678') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('pharmachemie', 'thymoorgan pharmazie', 'zydus lifesciences', 'elite')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-446393.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('pharmachemie', 'thymoorgan pharmazie', 'zydus lifesciences', 'elite', 'hikma', 'teva parenteral medicines') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%methotrexate%' ORDER BY initiation_date
